messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete: inference-service:v8 -> canary (streaming enabled). quick-smoke probes started. dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/3098765432
riley: running streaming-smoke x40 against eu-central. seeing ~6% truncated streams where client receives EOF before final token. sample: last chunk cut with incomplete JSON.
omar: paste sample (sanitized): `{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"The result is {\"score\": 0."` then abrupt EOF.
heidi: that's bad for structured outputs. any upstream errors? logs?
infra-bot: network flaps NOT detected. service logs show connection close events from our proxy layer around 12:27:11-12:27:14. Ticket INF-5102 opened.
riley: non-streaming probes (snapshot) return full payloads fine. suggests streaming path issue (proxy/ingress) not model.
omar: proposal: 1) pause streaming in eu-central (runtime flag), 2) keep hold on rollout for 15m, 3) re-run streaming-smoke and snapshot checks. If truncated rate stays >1%, keep streaming disabled for region and route to no-stream variant.
heidi: +1. prepare release note entry: "temporary streaming disabled in eu-central due to truncated stream errors during smoke tests; snapshot responses unaffected."
infra-bot: applied runtime flag: streaming:false for eu-central canary.
riley: re-run 100 snapshot+stream checks: snapshots 100/100 OK, streams now 0/100 truncated after flag change.
omar: infra tracing points to upstream proxy keepalive bug that drops chunks under load. INF-5102 assigned to proxy team.
deploy-bot: Canary policy: hold at 100% pending verification. Resume allowed once streaming path fixed and we re-enable, or if product approves longer-term snapshot-only mode. Archive: https://telemetry/internal/archives/3098765432
heidi: TL;DR: streaming truncation in eu-central; streaming disabled for region, hold rollout, proxy team investigating. Will follow up in release notes and INF-5102.
